## 新功能 / What's new

### 知识库重构 / Knowledge bases, restructured (macOS & Windows)
- 每个知识库分为 **简历、技能、项目、资料、自定义指令** 五部分，支持一键复制知识库、把条目“复制到…”其他知识库。
  Each knowledge base now has **Resume, Skills, Projects, Materials and Custom instructions**; duplicate a knowledge base or copy entries to another one.
- 上传简历时可选择 **用 AI 整理** 或 **只保存原文**（可记住选择，也可在设置中修改）。AI 会生成可编辑的 Markdown 原文、摘要和技能标签，摘要语言跟随简历原文。
  When uploading a resume, choose **Organize with AI** or **Save original only** (remembered, changeable in Settings). AI creates an editable Markdown original, a summary and skill tags in the resume's own language.
- 简历中带链接的项目（GitHub 仓库、演示网站等）会自动加入“项目”；PDF / Word 中隐藏在文字后的超链接也能识别。
  Projects linked in the resume (GitHub repositories, demo sites…) are added to Projects automatically, including links hidden behind text in PDF / Word files.
- 粘贴 GitHub 仓库或个人主页链接即可导入项目，并生成一句话摘要。
  Paste a GitHub repository or profile link to import projects with a one-line summary.

### 面试时主窗口自动让位 / Main window steps aside during interviews
- 打开提示板（开始面试或 Director Mode 主机）时，主窗口自动最小化；开启“面试时隐藏任务栏 / 程序坞”后会完全隐藏，关闭提示板后自动恢复。
  Opening the prompt board (interview or Director Mode host) minimizes the main window, or hides it completely when "hide from taskbar / Dock" is on; it comes back when the board closes.

### Windows
- 新增 **安装版**（`…-Windows-x64-Setup.exe`，推荐）：无需管理员权限，开始菜单可搜索，可创建桌面快捷方式，可在“设置 → 应用”中卸载。便携版 exe 继续提供。
  New **installer** (`…-Windows-x64-Setup.exe`, recommended): no admin rights, Start menu entry, optional desktop shortcut, uninstall from Settings → Apps. The portable exe is still available.
- **应用内更新**：发现新版本后点“立即更新”，应用内下载（带进度）、安装并自动重新打开，数据和设置保留。（从 1.1.0 升级需要手动下载这一次，之后即可应用内更新。）
  **In-app updates**: "Update Now" downloads with progress, installs and reopens the app, keeping your data. (Updating from 1.1.0 needs one manual download; later updates are in-app.)
- 更新提示、菜单等界面统一为应用风格。
  Update prompts and menus now use the app's own style.

### macOS
- Director Mode 在侧边栏展开时的排版问题已修复。
  Fixed the Director Mode layout when the sidebar is open.
